text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day is here. The academy
must be
bustling with activity at the
moment. Where we
are, though...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The snow's deep after the blizzard last
night.
Mind where you tread, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The forest is quiet. I don't know where
we're
going, but I'm so focused on trying
to keep up
that it doesn't occur to me to
ask for details.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh... Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's lower our sails here. We've walked
quite
some distance already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's obvious I'm slowing her down. If she
were by
herself, she'd be making much
better progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why she invited me along. Also,

somewhat surprisingly, it doesn't seem
like she's
about to vanish off somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's so peaceful... isn't it? The only sound
around
is that of the trees swaying in the
wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And yet, the air is rich with the breath of
life.
Look...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just over there, the buds beneath the
snow...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
They're a gallant gale that won't give in
to the
snow's weight or cold. Hehe...
How inspiring.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But I can feel the breath of life from
plenty of
other places too, all brought in
on the wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Each precious, tiny seed...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wish to become such a benison breeze
myself.
That's my hope.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well... if I am getting closer to becoming
the gale
I aspire to be, it is because I
have you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
With all the effort you put into training
me, I feel
as if I have all the support of a
great and
immovable oak tree.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And before my races, you wrap me in

warmth—like the sun...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You've given me so much—from still
serenity to
gallant gales. You're just like
the benison breeze I
wish to become.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That's why, today...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Here in this forest full of blessings, I
want to
convey my gratitude to you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That was my thinking.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And not just through words... I want to
channel a
wind that's appropriate for
today.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I may not be a benison breeze yet, but I
wish to
channel my feelings into this
mellow breeze...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And I hope it reaches you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon opening the box, the rich and
slightly bitter
fragrance of cacao rises up
to meet me. These
are... homemade
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Did you catch the balmy breeze? I used
a little
sugar cane to add sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The cacao was sent to me from overseas
by my
father. I hope you can taste a
little of the earth's
bounty.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I know I said "mellow breeze" a moment
ago, but I
felt a tempest swirling within.
There was no
calming it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So, how do you feel about this? Is it a
refreshing
breeze or an unwelcome
storm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bringing me out here must have been her
way of
showing how serious she is. I
gladly accept her
chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh... A refreshing breeze, then... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It may be a small one... but it's a step
towards my
becoming a benison breeze.
Hehe... This is my—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Cover your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Struck suddenly by the strongest gust of
the day,
our bodies are battered by
snow blown off the
tree branches.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The chocolates got covered in snow... I
suppose
with a squall like that, there's
nothing we could
have done.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... you're actually going to
eat them?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly what I'm going to do. I'm
going to
eat every last one of these
snowcapped
chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my... You're truly a gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Why not sit down and eat them? There's
a fallen
tree here that'll make for the
perfect spot.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Actually, you'd better stay an
unseated
easterly wind. The breath of
life is blowing by
your feet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. If I'd sat down, I would've
probably
crushed some flower buds.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I... That was an unexpected gust...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wonder what happened to the
snowy
winds?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Still, the floral winds of February
are
something else, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Take your time and enjoy those treats.
I hope
they taste as soft as the mellow
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take my time and carefully savor each
of the
painstakingly made chocolates.
